fusions.name: Off My Share
fusions.desc: A backhanded blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles away and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Troop's Due
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and every ally deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Jealous Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each kill you make restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Bared Teeth
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds, once every 8 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.
